newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips to cut stake in ASM Litho.
newsitem.headline: Philips to cut stake in ASM Litho.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Thursday it planned to sell 3.95 million ordinary shares in ASM Lithography by means of a public offering.
It said the move would reduce its stake in ASML Lithography to 23.9 percent from 35.4 percent at present.
Philips said completion of the offering would leave it with 8.25 million ordinary shares, adding that it had agreed with ASM Litho to retain ownership of these shares until March 22, 2000.
At the current Amsterdam bourse share price the offering would raise about 400 million guilders.
Philips said it would use the proceeds for "general corporate purposes". A spokesman declined to elaborate on this.
